app.name: DClaw Onboard
app.description: A next-generation onboarding platform powered by agentic AI. Skills-based journey mapping, automated compliance, DEI-embedded experiences, and hybrid-first design — everything modern HR teams need to welcome, equip, and retain top talent.

features.name: Agentic AI Onboarding
features.description: Autonomous AI agents that don't just answer questions — they act. Provision accounts, schedule 1:1s, assign training, and guide new hires through every step without human intervention.

hero.headline: AI That Doesn't Just Chat — It Acts
hero.subheadline: Agentic AI autonomously provisions, schedules, and guides. New hires get a 30-day plan generated in under 2 minutes, while AI handles the busywork in the background.

items.title: Autonomous Task Execution
items.description: AI agents provision SaaS accounts, create calendar invites, assign training modules, and send welcome emails — without a human clicking a button.

items.title: RAG-Powered Q&A
items.description: Answers new-hire questions by searching company wiki, policies, handbooks, and team docs in real time. Context-aware and hallucination-resistant.

items.title: Proactive Nudge Engine
items.description: Sends timely reminders for pending tasks, upcoming meetings, and learning deadlines. Detects disengagement and escalates to managers automatically.

items.title: Personalized 30/60/90 Plans
items.description: Generates role-specific onboarding plans with milestones, skill-building resources, and check-in points — tailored by seniority, department, and location.

items.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
items.description: Multiple AI agents collaborate — the IT agent provisions hardware, the HR agent handles compliance, the buddy agent schedules coffee chats.

items.title: Local-First AI Fallback
items.description: Falls back to local Ollama models when cloud AI is unavailable. Zero latency, always responsive, GDPR-compliant on-premise option.

items.label: AI Stack
items.value: RAG + OpenRouter Kimi K2.5 + Ollama fallback

items.label: Reminder Engine
items.value: Scheduled background tasks with engagement detection

features.name: Skills-Based Journey Builder
features.description: Move beyond role-based checklists. Map onboarding to your organization's skills taxonomy, identify competency gaps, and generate personalized learning journeys for every new hire.

hero.headline: Skills-Based Organizations Start on Day One
hero.subheadline: Forget generic checklists. Map every new hire to your skills taxonomy, auto-generate personalized learning paths, and close competency gaps from the moment they join.

items.title: Skills Taxonomy Integration
items.description: Connect to your organization's skills framework (Lightcast, EMSI, or custom taxonomy). Every onboarding task maps to specific competencies.

items.title: Gap-Analysis Engine
items.description: Compare new hire skills against role requirements. Auto-generate personalized learning paths that close gaps in the first 90 days.

items.title: Visual Dependency Graph
items.description: Drag-and-drop journey builder with intelligent dependency mapping. Prerequisite tasks auto-block dependents until completed.

items.title: Competency Progress Tracking
items.description: Real-time visualization of skill acquisition. Managers see which competencies are developing and which need attention.

items.title: 50+ Industry Templates
items.description: Pre-built skills maps for Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Product, Design, Finance, and Executive roles. Customize or build from scratch.

items.title: Auto-Assign + Smart Deadlines
items.description: Tasks auto-assign to the right person with relative deadlines (Day 1, Day 7, Day 30) calculated from the start date.

items.label: Skill gap visibility from day one
Average time to customize a journey
Backend Engine
items.value: Skills dependency graph + gap analysis engine

features.name: Document Collection & E-Sign
features.description: AI-validated document collection with built-in e-signature. Auto-request I-9, W-4, contracts, and policy acknowledgments. Compliance scoring for every document.

hero.headline: Documents That Validate Themselves
hero.subheadline: AI checks every uploaded document for completeness, legibility, and expiration. E-signature built in. Compliance scoring for every file. Zero manual review.

items.title: AI Document Validation
items.description: Automatically checks uploaded documents for completeness, legibility, expiration dates, and fraud indicators. Flags issues before HR review.

items.title: Auto-Request Workflow
items.description: Automatically requests I-9, W-4, direct deposit, NDAs, and policy acknowledgments based on role, location, and jurisdiction. Zero manual follow-ups.

items.title: Built-In E-Signature
items.description: Legally binding electronic signatures for offer letters, contracts, and policy acknowledgments. Complete audit trail for every signature.

items.title: Visual Document Checklist
items.description: Clear, mobile-friendly checklist with status indicators. Drag-and-drop upload widgets. Progress celebration on completion.

items.title: Compliance Scoring
items.description: Every document receives a compliance score. Dashboard shows overall completion health. Audit-ready reports one click away.

items.title: Smart Reminders
items.description: Gentle, escalating reminders for overdue documents. AI adjusts tone and frequency based on new-hire engagement patterns.

items.label: Backend
items.value: Document workflow + AI validation pipeline + MinIO storage

items.label: AI Validation
items.value: Computer vision for document scanning + NLP for content checks

features.name: Compliance Auto-Pilot
features.description: AI-powered regulatory compliance that monitors changing laws across jurisdictions, auto-adjusts requirements, and generates audit trails. Never miss a compliance deadline again.

hero.headline: Regulatory Compliance on Autopilot
hero.subheadline: 50 states. GDPR. EU AI Act. E-Verify. Right-to-work. AI monitors every jurisdiction, auto-adjusts your onboarding requirements, and keeps you audit-ready 24/7.

items.title: Multi-Jurisdiction Monitoring
items.description: AI continuously tracks employment laws across US states, EU member states, and APAC jurisdictions. Requirements auto-update when regulations change.

items.title: Auto-Adjusting Checklists
items.description: Document collection, policy acknowledgments, and training requirements automatically adjust based on employee location and applicable laws.

items.title: Real-Time Compliance Scoring
items.description: Every new hire gets a live compliance score. Red/yellow/green indicators show risk levels. Drill down to see exactly what's missing.

items.title: E-Verify & Right-to-Work
items.description: Direct integration with government verification systems. Automated I-9 verification with E-Verify. Right-to-work checks for UK and Australia.

items.title: Audit Trail Generation
items.description: Every compliance action is logged with timestamp, user, and context. One-click audit report generation for internal or external auditors.

items.title: GDPR & Data Residency
items.description: Automatic data handling based on employee location. EU data stays in EU. Encryption at rest and in transit. Data retention policies enforced.

items.label: Backend
items.value: Compliance rules engine + regulatory change monitor

items.label: Integrations
items.value: E-Verify, UK Right-to-Work, EU GDPR compliance APIs

items.label: AI
items.value: NLP for regulatory text analysis + automated rule extraction

features.name: Equipment & Access Provisioning
features.description: Zero-touch equipment requests, software license provisioning, and access group assignments. AI agents handle IT tickets and track shipments autonomously.

hero.headline: Day-One Ready, Zero Human Touch
hero.subheadline: Laptop configured. Accounts provisioned. Software activated. AI agents handle the entire IT workflow — from ticket creation to shipment tracking — autonomously.

items.title: Zero-Touch Provisioning
items.description: AI agents automatically create accounts in Okta/Azure AD, assign to correct groups, and provision SaaS licenses — no IT ticket required.

items.title: Equipment Catalog
items.description: Role-based equipment bundles with automatic selection. Engineering gets a MacBook Pro. Sales gets a ThinkPad. Zero configuration drift.

items.title: Agentic IT Workflows
items.description: AI agent creates the IT ticket, orders the hardware, configures MDM enrollment, and tracks the shipment. HR and IT just watch.

items.title: Automated Deprovisioning
items.description: When offboarding is triggered, AI agents revoke access across all systems, wipe devices via MDM, and generate a completion report.

features.name: DEI-Embedded Onboarding
features.description: Diversity, equity, and inclusion baked into every onboarding interaction — from inclusive language checks to bias-aware buddy matching and ERG introductions.

hero.headline: Inclusion Isn't a Module — It's the Foundation
hero.subheadline: From inclusive language analysis to bias-aware buddy matching, DEI is embedded in every step of the onboarding journey. Because belonging starts on day zero.

items.title: Inclusive Language Analysis
items.description: AI scans all onboarding content — job descriptions, welcome emails, training docs — for biased or exclusionary language. Suggests inclusive alternatives.

items.title: Bias-Aware Buddy Matching
items.description: Buddy matching algorithm avoids demographic clustering. Considers diverse perspectives, shared interests, and complementary skills for richer connections.

items.title: Accessibility-First Design
items.description: All onboarding interfaces meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards. Screen-reader compatible, keyboard-navigable, with contrast and text-sizing controls.

items.title: ERG Introduction Engine
items.description: Based on self-identification, new hires are introduced to relevant Employee Resource Groups with a personalized welcome from ERG leads.

items.title: Pronoun & Name Respect
items.description: Pronoun collection with respect-first defaults. Phonetic name pronunciation capture. Auto-populated across all onboarding materials.

items.title: Belonging Micro-Surveys
items.description: 2-question pulse surveys at Day 1, 7, and 30 measuring psychological safety and belonging. Anonymous by default with trend dashboards.

features.name: Manager Command Center
features.description: Not just a dashboard — a command center. See onboarding progress, receive AI-powered alerts, and take action directly: reassign tasks, schedule check-ins, or escalate concerns.

hero.headline: Don't Just Watch — Act
hero.subheadline: Real-time progress for every direct report. AI flags at-risk new hires. One-click interventions. Because managers shouldn't need five tools to onboard one person.

items.title: Unified Progress Command
items.description: Single view of every direct report's onboarding — checklist completion, skill acquisition, document status, and wellness pulse in one screen.

items.title: AI Risk Detection
items.description: ML models analyze engagement patterns, survey responses, and task velocity to flag new hires at risk of disengagement or early departure.

items.title: One-Click Interventions
items.description: When risk is flagged, AI suggests concrete actions — schedule a check-in, reassign a buddy, adjust workload — with one-click execution.

items.title: Multi-Channel Alerts
items.description: Smart alerts for stalled journeys, missed milestones, and low wellness scores. Delivered via Slack, Teams, email, or push notification.

items.title: Weekly Intelligence Reports
items.description: AI-generated weekly summaries with trend analysis, key milestones achieved, and recommended focus areas for the coming week.

items.title: Wellness Signal Integration
items.description: Correlates onboarding progress with wellness and belonging signals. Identifies when slow progress is a symptom of deeper issues.

items.label: Average response time to risk flags

features.name: Wellness & Belonging Pulse
features.description: ISO 45003-aligned psychological safety and belonging checks at Day 7, 30, 60, and 90. AI detects burnout signals and recommends interventions before they escalate.

hero.headline: Psychological Safety Starts on Day One
hero.subheadline: Burnout doesn't start at month six — it starts when onboarding fails. Micro-checks for psychological safety, belonging, and wellbeing at every milestone.

items.title: Psychological Safety Checks
items.description: ISO 45003-aligned micro-surveys measuring psychological safety, role clarity, and team belonging. Anonymous by default to encourage honesty.

items.title: Burnout Signal Detection
items.description: AI analyzes response patterns, task completion velocity, and engagement signals to detect early burnout indicators. Alerts managers before crisis hits.

items.title: Belonging Trend Analysis
items.description: Track how belonging scores evolve from Day 1 through Day 90. Demographic-aware trend lines to identify systemic inclusion gaps.

items.title: Intervention Recommendations
items.description: When wellness signals decline, AI recommends personalized interventions — team check-in, workload adjustment, buddy re-match, or manager coaching.

items.label: Time to complete a pulse check

features.name: Hybrid-First Experience
features.description: Onboarding designed for distributed teams from the ground up. Async-first workflows, virtual social events, and digital culture immersion — no second-class remote experience.

hero.headline: Distributed Teams Deserve Great Onboarding Too
hero.subheadline: Async-first onboarding workflows, virtual coffee roulette, digital office tours, and culture cards that work whether you're in-office or 10 time zones away.

items.title: Async-First Workflows
items.description: Every onboarding task, document, and training module works async by default. Live sessions are optional, recorded, and transcribed for later viewing.

items.title: Virtual Social Experiences
items.description: AI-powered coffee chat roulette, virtual team trivia, and digital office tours. Build real connections without being in the same room.

items.title: Digital Culture Immersion
items.description: Interactive modules on company history, values, and traditions — designed for solo exploration with social sharing features.

items.title: Time-Zone-Aware Scheduling
items.description: All meetings, deadlines, and reminders adapt to the new hire's time zone. No more 5am onboarding calls.

features.name: AI-Generated Learning Paths
features.description: Skills-gap-driven curriculum generation. AI maps new hire competencies against role requirements and auto-enrolls them in DClaw Learn courses to close gaps.

hero.headline: Close Skill Gaps Before They Become Problems
hero.subheadline: AI analyzes the gap between what a new hire knows and what their role demands. Generates a personalized curriculum and auto-enrolls them in the right courses.

items.title: Skills-Gap-Driven Curriculum
items.description: AI compares new hire competencies against role requirements and generates a personalized learning path prioritized by impact.

items.title: Auto-Enrollment Engine
items.description: Automatically enrolls new hires in DClaw Learn courses. Tracks completion, sends smart reminders, and adapts pace based on progress.

items.title: Competency Progress Visualization
items.description: Visual dashboards showing skill acquisition over time. Managers see which competencies are growing and which need reinforcement.

items.title: Just-in-Time Micro-Learning
items.description: Bite-sized learning modules delivered at the moment of need — not a 40-hour course dumped on day one.

features.name: Pre-Day-1 Engagement
features.description: Mobile-first candidate engagement between offer acceptance and Day 1. Async content delivery, team teasers, and first-day prep to reduce ghosting by 50%.

hero.headline: The Gap Between 'Yes' and Day 1 Is Everything
hero.subheadline: Keep new hires warm with mobile-first content, team introductions, and first-day prep. Modern pre-boarding that cuts ghosting rates in half.

items.title: Mobile-First Experience
items.description: All pre-start content optimized for mobile. New hires engage on their phone — no laptop required. Push notifications for key updates.

items.title: Async Content Drip
items.description: Scheduled content delivery — welcome message on Day 0, team intro on Day -7, first-day prep on Day -1. Keeps excitement building.

items.title: Team Teaser Cards
items.description: Digital cards with photos, fun facts, and welcome messages from future teammates. Builds familiarity and reduces first-day anxiety.

items.title: Ghosting Prevention AI
items.description: Engagement tracking with smart re-engagement. AI detects when a candidate is going cold and triggers personalized outreach automatically.

items.title: First-Day Logistics Hub
items.description: Everything a new hire needs to know — where to go, what to bring, dress code, parking, WiFi password — in one mobile-friendly page.

items.title: Swag & Excitement Builder
items.description: Digital unboxing experiences, company swag selection, and welcome video from the CEO. Turn anticipation into excitement.

features.name: Stakeholder Introductions
features.description: Auto-schedule 1:1s with key stakeholders. AI-generated intro briefs for every meeting. DEI-aware matching that prioritizes diverse perspectives from day one.

hero.headline: First Conversations Shouldn't Be Awkward
hero.subheadline: Auto-scheduled 1:1s with AI-generated intro briefs. New hires walk into every meeting knowing who they're talking to, why they matter, and what to ask.

items.title: DEI-Aware Matching
items.description: Introductions algorithm ensures new hires meet diverse perspectives — not just people who look like them or share their background.

items.title: AI-Generated Intro Briefs
items.description: For each meeting: who they're meeting, their background, what they do, suggested talking points, and shared interests.

items.title: Async-First Scheduling
items.description: Meetings auto-schedule respecting both parties' time zones and calendar availability. No back-and-forth DMs.

items.title: Org Chart Intelligence
items.description: Automatically maps reporting chain, skip-level, and key collaborators. Prioritizes introductions by organizational impact.

items.title: Meeting Context Cards
items.description: Mobile-friendly cards with photo, bio, fun facts, and discussion topics. Reviewable in 60 seconds before walking into any meeting.

items.title: Introduction Analytics
items.description: Track which introductions happened, which were rescheduled, and how new hires rate their first conversations.

features.name: Gamification & Achievements
features.description: Onboarding badges, progress celebrations, and team leaderboards that turn mandatory tasks into motivating milestones. Earn achievements for completing your first 30-day journey.

hero.headline: Onboarding That Feels Like Leveling Up
hero.subheadline: Turn checklists into achievements. Celebrate milestones, earn badges, and climb the leaderboard with teammates who joined the same week.

items.title: Achievement Badges
items.description: Earn badges for completing key onboarding milestones — first task done, first 1:1 scheduled, first training completed, full 30-day journey finished.

items.title: Progress Celebrations
items.description: Confetti moments, streak counters, and animated celebrations when new hires hit significant milestones. Makes the mundane feel meaningful.

items.title: Cohort Leaderboards
items.description: Friendly competition among new hires who joined the same week or month. Opt-in leaderboards with privacy controls — no pressure, all fun.

items.title: Manager Recognition Triggers
items.description: When a new hire hits a big milestone, their manager gets a nudge to send a personal congrats message. Builds connection at the right moment.

items.label: More onboarding engagement vs no gamification
First badge available from the start

features.name: Offboarding Companion
features.description: Smooth handoff to the dclaw-offboard module when employees depart. Knowledge transfer workflows, exit interviews, access revocation, and alumni network enrollment — all automated.

hero.headline: Great Offboarding Is the Last Impression You Make
hero.subheadline: Departing employees become brand ambassadors or detractors. Automated knowledge transfer, dignified exit flows, and alumni network enrollment — all in one companion.

items.title: Knowledge Transfer Workflows
items.description: Structured handoff checklists, documentation templates, and AI-assisted knowledge capture to preserve critical context before an employee leaves.

items.title: Automated Access Revocation
items.description: On offboarding trigger, AI agents revoke all SaaS access, disable identity provider accounts, and generate a complete access-removal audit trail.

items.title: AI-Powered Exit Interview
items.description: Conversational AI conducts the exit interview at the employee's pace. Sentiment analysis surfaces systemic themes. Anonymous summaries shared with HR.

items.title: Alumni Network Enrollment
items.description: Automatically invites departing employees to the company alumni network. Boomerang re-hire pipeline built in from day one of departure.

items.label: Boomerang hire rate from alumni network
